title: The day before an exam doesn’t need to be a crisis. #engineering #engineeringdegree #exam #students
transcript: People when they think of exams they think stress they think anxiety they they they start doing all crazy sorts of stuff they stop eating they stop sleeping yeah silliness foolishness terrible ideas okay for your exam live your life like you normally live your life if you're putting the hard work in you don't need to create some sort of drastic changes in your life for day before the exam relax go to the gym speak to your friends eat some nice food go to sleep at a reasonable time don't give yourself more stress less than you need to. The test itself when you sit down on an example is going to be stressful.
